gloss: move one can make; recourse; available countermeasure

definitions.gloss: move one can make; recourse; available countermeasure
definitions.explanation: A course of action still open in a difficult situation. Taken from board games, where {手|て} is a move and {打|う}つ is to play a stone or piece, so the word frames a problem as a game position with moves left or none.

examples.english: There is nothing more we can do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}つ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: We all thought about what move to make next.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{落|お}ち→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{打|う}つ{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Sales keep falling, but the company still has moves left to make.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{打|う}つ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、あと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{返|かえ}す→取り返す：06050_torikaesu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you make the wrong move at an early stage, it becomes hard to recover later.

notes:
Nearly always used in a small set of patterns rather than freely, and most often in the negative — the phrase {打|う}つ{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ is far more frequent than the positive statement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {打|う}つ{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no options left
- {打|う}つ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think about what to do
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}つ{手|て}: the next move
- {打|う}つ{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: to be too slow to act

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasure — neutral and concrete; the word used in plans and documents
- ⟦{手|て}を{打|う}つ→手を打つ：07450_tewoutsu⟧: to take action — the verb phrase from which this noun comes
